projects.title: Captura
projects.description: Premium camera hire for KL creators who refuse to shoot on a phone. Equipment browsing, booking, and an admin panel that keeps the gear (and the chaos) in check.

ui.headline: RENT. SHOOT. REPEAT.
ui.sub: Full-frame bodies and cinema lenses, booked in minutes.

specs.deadpoolNote: Literally rents out the cameras the site was filmed on. Full circle, zero plot holes.

projects.title: Pretty Local KL
projects.description: A fashion and lifestyle storefront putting Malaysian labels where KL shoppers will actually find them. Editorial polish, zero "everything is imported" energy.

ui.headline: LOCAL STYLE. FRESH DROPS.
ui.sub: Malaysian labels, one edit at a time.

specs.deadpoolNote: Loads faster than a KL traffic jam clears. Low bar, still counts.

projects.title: SimplePOS
projects.description: A point-of-sale that skips the three-day training course. Order entry, payments, and reporting that get out of your way before the lunch rush does.

ui.headline: ORDER. PAY. DONE.
ui.sub: No bloat, no training manual, no queues.

specs.deadpoolNote: Rings up orders faster than you can explain today's specials. Ka-ching.

projects.title: Hazicolaw
projects.description: The website for Haziq Azhari & Co., a Kuala Lumpur law practice. Ten practice areas, the two partners behind them, and an enquiry flow built to turn a nervous first call into a booked consultation.

ui.headline: SERIOUS COUNSEL. CLEAR ANSWERS.
ui.sub: Ten practice areas, two partners, one straightforward first step.

specs.deadpoolNote: Ten practice areas, two partners, and an enquiry form that won't bill you for the first hello.
